target_customer: Revenue cycle teams at provider practices, physician groups, MSOs and RCM companies
problem: Denied, underpaid and unanswered claims and aged accounts receivable consume revenue cycle staff time and leak revenue.
business_model: Outcome-based fee, paid on what it recovers, using AI agents plus human expert review
product_category: AI denial management and accounts receivable recovery

founders.name: Kaushik ASP
prior_employers: Emergent (YC S24), hire number 2 leading full-stack engineering
founders.background_notes: YC page: built early infrastructure for long-running agents at Emergent.

competitors.name: Amperos Health
competitors.what: AI-native denial management and revenue recovery platform
competitors.funding_then: $16M Series A led by Bessemer Venture Partners

competitors.name: RapidClaims
competitors.what: RapidRecovery AI denial model with voice AI for payer follow-up

technical_complexity.rationale: Agents working claims across payer portals, clearinghouses and EHRs need many integrations and human review loops, but this is standard automation engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Learned fixes retained across claims may create some lock-in, but funded rivals and RCM incumbents sell similar recovery and the product is largely software built on general models.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Too early to say. RCM incumbents shipped AI denial and recovery products through 2026.

market_need_then: Denials and underpayments are a recognized cost for providers, and multiple vendors raised money or launched denial products in April 2026. The need is shown by competitor activity rather than Tago customer evidence.

branding.domain_note: Uses tagohealth.com; the legal entity remains BentoLabs AI Inc.

rebrands.why: Not stated; the YC page only says formerly BentoLabs AI. Date unknown.

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community found; searches for the name return unrelated health brands and the rename is undocumented.

pivots.from: Bento, a monitoring and learning layer for long-running AI agents (BentoLabs AI)
pivots.to: AI denial and A/R recovery for healthcare revenue cycle teams (Tago Health)
pivots.why: Not stated by sources; the pivot is inferred from the old YC listing description versus the current site and the rename, date unknown.

outcome_analysis: Tago Health, formerly BentoLabs AI, is a Spring 2026 YC company that is active with no outcome yet. It appears to have moved from agent monitoring to healthcare revenue recovery, so the questions are founder-market fit in a crowded, funded category and whether the outcome-based pricing yields enough recovered revenue.
notes: The YC page lists only Kaushik ASP as founder. A search result summary says the older BentoLabs AI YC page names Abhinav Soni, but that came from a third-party site, so he is not listed. VCBacked shows $500K pre-seed for Bento Labs dated 2026-04; single aggregator, unverified, not recorded as a round. Tago site says Backed by Y Combinator and OpenAI with no amounts. Outcome search found nothing.
